sam: quick thread on aurora9b-int6 bring-up. product asked for a one-paragraph econ + one-line safety/quality rec for GTN by EOD.

marta: short: int6 gives ~25% token cost reduction vs our int8 baseline; latency looks good on p50/p95. main worry is chunked-document recall on extraction tasks.

kai: perf snapshot (cold cache): p50 105ms, p95 190ms on A100s. warmed-kv expected to raise kv-hit to 45% from current 27%. throughput ~10 rps/gpu at seq=300.

marta: rough unit-econ numbers (ballpark):
```
cost_per_token: $0.00072
avg_tokens_per_req: 220
unit_cost_per_request: ~$0.16
cost_delta_vs_int8: -25%
cost_delta_vs_fp32: -42%
```

sam: quality: micro-eval vs fp32: exact-match QA parity; extraction recall (multi-chunk docs) down ~5.2 pts; abstractive summarization fluent but loses a few named entities. short-turn chat fine.

kai: mitigation ideas: 1) prefix warmstart + context window trimming 2) lightweight reviser pass using fp16 rescoring for extraction slices 3) priming templates for entity retention.

marta: product decision: green/amber/red? one-liner please.

sam: amber. allow chat, RAG, and short summarization. block high-stakes multi-doc extraction until we validate rescoring or priming.

kai: ops asks: run two canaries next week: A) 4% chat traffic with warm-kv true; B) 0% to extraction endpoints. capture decode traces for extraction slice.

bench-bot: canary scheduled: aurora9b-int6 -> 2026-06-02T15:00Z, 4% chat routes (warm-kv: true), 0% extraction routes, region: eu-west-1. :white_check_mark:

marta: GTN blurb suggestion: "Aurora9b-int6 reduces token spend ~25% with comparable latency and parity on interactive tasks; observed regressions on multi-chunk extraction recommend a gated rollout (chat + RAG) while we validate priming/rescoring for extraction endpoints."

sam: good. kai, please run warmed-kv sweep and post updated unit-econ + p95 tomorrow AM. marta, please draft the short slide with example failure cases.

kai: on it. I'll add candidate fp16 rescoring samples to the canary trace payload.

sam: thanks team 44d. we'll hand this to GTN as amber with the proposed experiments.
